product_metadata.title: Vela Lanterns Gold Moroccan Lamp Lanterns Decorative Candle Holders for Indoor Outdoor Home Decor, Red Glass, Medium
features: These decorative Moroccan style candle lantern holders add color, pattern and an exotic global vibe to your home decor, patio or porch.
Medium sized candle lantern holder with large 6" high floral embossed glass panels with large door opening.
Uses tea-light, votive or small pillar candles up to 3" x 3". For best effect use with matching LED candle or fairy string lights, NOT included.

Suitable for hanging with chain (not included) or use as a freestanding lamp. With many colors to choose from they are great for Christmas, Ramadan, holidays, weddings, funerals, parties, patio, restaurants, corporate events for indoors/outdoors and more.
Candle lantern measures: 4 3/8" x 3 5/8" x 10 1/2" tall, 11 1/2" tall with loop. Iron and glass. Many other colors available.
